title: Tectonic Globe
excerpt: A rotatable Earth that drags today's countries and major cities through the Merdith 2021 plate reconstruction model, plus a simple future extrapolation. Continents keep their color families while the land follows plate motion from 1000 million years ago to 250 million years ahead.
content_html:
Modern Earth 0 Ma

Today's countries and cities are used as colored crust markers. Country polygons are split by the present-day static polygons from the Merdith 2021 plate model, then each country-on-plate fragment is reconstructed backward with pyGPlates finite rotations. The future side is a constant-motion extrapolation from young plate rotations with a few coarse collision handoffs, so treat it as an interactive sketch rather than a forecast. Red areas mark plate fragments that still overlap after reconstruction.

momentum, n.: What you give a person when they are going away.

现代地球 0 Ma

今天的国家和城市被用作彩色地壳标记。 国家多边形由 Merdith 2021 板块模型中的当前静态多边形分割，然后使用 pyGPlates 有限旋转向后重建每个国家板块片段。 未来的一面是根据年轻板块旋转进行的恒定运动推断，并进行一些粗略的碰撞切换，因此请将其视为交互式草图而不是预测。 红色区域标记重建后仍然重叠的板碎片。
